UMBC Academic Program Search
Located conveniently between Washington D.C. and Baltimore, Maryland, UMBC offers 300 programs at undergraduate and graduate levels, spanning STEM fields, arts, humanities, and social sciences.
As a public university, our curriculum aligns with key industries like healthcare, biotechnology, and professional services. UMBC's location provides unique opportunities: study with renowned faculty, engage in cutting-edge research, and gain real-world experience. Join us to prepare for success in today's dynamic job market.
